title: Spanish trip page testimonial is in English, in faint white-on-pale text
what_happened: On /es-LA Conexiones Culturales, the 'Historias de Transformación' testimonial is entirely in English. It is in italic white text over a very pale blue panel, so it is hard to read. The homepage carousel tabs ('July 2026 Bulletin', 'How We're Born') are also in English.
expected: The testimonial in Spanish (or a translation), with readable contrast. A partner I forward this page to would see a half-translated page.

title: Trip details (price, dates, length) are only in an invite-only participant portal
what_happened: After four pages (Qué Hacemos, Conexiones Culturales, Involúcrate, Viajes) I had seen no price, price range, trip length, dates, group size, safety or insurance information. The Viajes page only says that people who have been invited can see their trip details, registration and resources in the 'Portal de Viajes'. A prospective group organizer has no public path to those facts.
expected: A public overview for institutions: sample itinerary, typical length (e.g. 7–10 days), a price range per student, group size, how safety, lodging and insurance are handled, and a 'group inquiry' link or named coordinator.
